# Edifier R1700BT IR codes (no remote needed)

From the open [Flipper-IRDB](https://github.com/Lucaslhm/Flipper-IRDB) (`Speakers/Edifier/Edifier_R1700BT.ir` and `Audio_and_Video_Receivers/Edifier/Edifier_r1700bt.ir`), converted to Pronto hex for HAIR's **Clipper** tab. All are NEC, address `0x10`.

Edifier made two remotes for this speaker and they use different codes. Try **Volume up** from set A; if the speaker doesn't react, use set B.

In Home Assistant: **HAIR → Clipper** → paste a code → **Test** → save it to your *Speakers* device under the name shown.

## Set A (includes Power)

**Power** (NEC 0x10 / 0x01)
```
0000 006D 0022 0000 0156 00AB 0015 0015 0015 0015 0015 0015 0015 0015 0015 0040 0015 0015 0015 0015 0015 0015 0015 0040 0015 0040 0015 0040 0015 0015 0015 0015 0015 0040 0015 0040 0015 0040 0015 0040 0015 0015 0015 0015 0015 0015 0015 0015 0015 0015 0015 0015 0015 0015 0015 0015 0015 0040 0015 0040 0015 0040 0015 0040 0015 0040 0015 0040 0015 0040 0015 0689
```

## Then in ember.json
Name the HAIR buttons `button.edifier_bluetooth` and `button.edifier_line_in` (or change the ids under the *Speakers* `controls` to match).
